# staticform_notion_connection (Resource)

A Notion integration connection, created from an internal integration token. Referenced by `SyncNotionDatabaseAction` submit actions via its `id`. Attributes are immutable; changing any forces a new connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Notion internal integration token. Validated against Notion on create; stored encrypted, never returned.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the connection has been revoked.
